name: Eco-Index Biodiversity Dashboards
description: Digital dashboards and related tools help users to monitor and set goals around biodiversity levels.

name: ODK
description: ODK lets you build powerful forms to collect the data you need wherever it is. Join the leading researchers, field teams, and other professionals using ODK to collect data that matters.

name: OpenFn
description: OpenFn is a workflow automation platform that's used to automate & integrate critical business processes and systems. From last-mile services to national-level reporting, it boosts efficiency & effectiveness while enabling secure, stable, scalable interoperability at all levels.

name: QField
description: Survey and digitize data in the field with seamless synchronization QField focuses on efficiently getting GIS fieldwork done and exchanging data between the field and the office in a comfortable and user-friendly way.

name: QGIS
description: QGIS is a full-featured, user-friendly, free-and-open-source (FOSS) geographical information system (GIS) that runs on Unix platforms, Windows, and MacOS.

name: Rural Environmental Registry Registration Module
description: The Rural Environmental Registry (RER) is a solution for managing declared geospatial environmental information on rural properties to serve as a database for control, monitoring, environmental and economic planning.

name: Sunbird
description: ROA is an innovative software tool designed to simplify the record-keeping process for farmers and agribusinesses, ensuring compliance with organic standards and EU Regulation 2018/848 for organic agriculture.

name: VIPS
description: Open platform for automatic pest prediction in agriculture created by NIBIO, Norway

name: Zamba
description: AI tools for wildlife monitoring with camera trap videos. Zamba is a command-line tool built in Python to automatically identify the species seen in camera trap videos from sites in central Africa. The tool makes predictions for 24 common species in these videos.
